WPFMaxSmartBulkRename.Description: Interactive batch file and folder renamer with real-time preview, regular expressions, and sequence numbering.

WPFMaxOneDriveExclusion.Description: Stops OneDrive from syncing selected folders (like WindowsPowerShell or node_modules) or files, keeping them local on your PC.

WPFMaxTakeOwnershipAdd.Content: Take Ownership - Add to Context Menu
WPFMaxTakeOwnershipAdd.Description: Adds 'Take Full Ownership' to Windows Explorer context menu with critical OS root safeguards.

WPFMaxTakeOwnershipRemove.Content: Take Ownership - Remove from Context Menu
WPFMaxTakeOwnershipRemove.Description: Removes 'Take Full Ownership' context menu entries from Windows Explorer.

WPFMaxSuperGodMode.Description: Launches ThioJoe's Windows Super God Mode to create shortcuts to all special shell folders, deep links, and Windows settings.

WPFMaxDesktopShortcut.Description: Creates or updates a permanent 1-click desktop shortcut for WinUtil-MAX with the Max Mayfield photo icon, launching from GitHub with execution policy bypass.

WPFMaxDesktopShortcutRemove.Description: Removes the WinUtil-MAX desktop shortcut and cleans up cached icon files.

WPFMaxBitLockerPolicy.Content: BitLocker Startup Password Policy (No TPM / Dual Boot)
WPFMaxBitLockerPolicy.Description: Enables Group Policy to allow BitLocker pre-boot Startup Password without requiring TPM. Essential for dual-boot systems where another OS uses the TPM, preventing PCR conflicts.

WPFMaxInstallClaude.Description: Installs or launches Anthropic's Claude Code terminal coding agent (@anthropic-ai/claude-code via npm).

WPFMaxInstallOmniRoute.Description: Installs or launches OmniRoute local AI model router, proxy, and failover gateway.
